title: Walk, Don't Run
description: A British businessman (Cary Grant) shares an apartment with a U.S. athlete (Jim Hutton) and a diplomat's fiancée (Samantha Eggar) during the Tokyo Olympics.

title: You Were Never Lovelier
description: A tycoon (Adolphe Menjou) sends anonymous gifts to his daughter (Rita Hayworth) to make her fall for a mystery man he will choose later, but a dancer (Fred Astaire) he doesn't like takes the credit.

title: Phffft!
description: Being with a blonde (Kim Novak) and a bachelor makes a divorced lawyer (Jack Lemmon) and TV writer (Judy Holliday) want to be back together.

title: The Chase
description: An escaped convict (Robert Redford) heads for his wife (Jane Fonda) and corrupt small-town Texans, who order a sheriff (Marlon Brando) to stop him.

title: The Bitter Tea of General Yen
description: A U.S. missionary (Barbara Stanwyck) is gradually seduced by a courtly warlord (Nils Asther) holding her in Shanghai.

title: Don't Knock the Twist
description: Rock 'n' rollers (Chubby Checker, Gene Chandler, Vic Dana) put on a TV dance special.

title: Bonjour tristesse
description: At the height of summer, 18-year-old Cécile is relaxing by the French seaside with her father and falling in love with her new boyfriend. However, the arrival of her late mother's enigmatic friend soon turns her world upside down.

title: Jeanne Eagels
description: A 1920s dancer/actress (Kim Novak) leaves her jealous lover (Jeff Chandler) for Broadway, Hollywood and alcoholic decline.

title: The Daring Young Man
description: After the military turns him down as being unfit, a man proves himself a hero by cracking a Nazi spy ring.

title: Pal Joey
description: A singer (Frank Sinatra) flirts with a chorus girl (Kim Novak) from Albuquerque after a San Francisco socialite (Rita Hayworth) buys him a nightclub.

title: It Should Happen to You
description: An executive (Peter Lawford) and a filmmaker (Jack Lemmon) woo a model (Judy Holliday) famous for having her name on a billboard.

title: Divorce American Style
description: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.

title: The Big Heat
description: When his investigation into a corrupt cop's suicide spawns a car bombing that takes the life of his wife, Police Sergeant Dave Bannion quits the force to pursue the case on his own.

title: The Harder They Fall
description: A fight promoter (Rod Steiger) hires a hard-luck sportswriter (Humphrey Bogart) to hype a simple Argentine boxer for the mob.

title: The Ambushers
description: A secret agent (Dean Martin) saves a flying-saucer prototype and its pilot (Janice Rule) in the third of four Matt Helm movies.

title: The Mating of Millie
description: A businesswoman (Evelyn Keyes) asks a bachelor (Glenn Ford) to help her find a husband so she can adopt an orphan.

title: You Belong to Me
description: A doctor's (Barbara Stanwyck) idle millionaire husband (Henry Fonda) becomes unbearably jealous of her patients.

title: Three on a Couch
description: An artist tries to help his psychiatrist fiancée by posing as suitors for her lovesick patients.

title: Miss Grant Takes Richmond
description: A bookie's (William Holden) innocent new secretary (Lucille Ball) thinks she's working in a real-estate office.

title: Born Free
description: The British Adamsons raise Elsa the lioness as a pet in Kenya, then teach her how to be wild again.

title: The Doctor Takes a Wife
description: A writer (Loretta Young) and a neurologist (Ray Milland) accept rumors of their marriage when each stands to gain from the mistake.

title: Gidget Grows Up
description: Gidget goes to New York, becomes a U.N. guide and meets an older man.

title: Harriet Craig
description: A businessman's (Wendell Corey) wife (Joan Crawford) is obsessed with running their household and his life, her way.

title: Anatomy of a Murder
description: A Michigan lawyer (James Stewart) and his colleague defend an Army lieutenant (Ben Gazzara) who killed the man who raped the officer's wife (Lee Remick).

title: Good Neighbor Sam
description: A San Francisco adman (Jack Lemmon) poses as his wife's friend's (Romy Schneider) husband so that she can inherit $15 million.

title: 711 Ocean Drive
description: A telephone repairman (Edmond O'Brien) becomes the boss of a gambling syndicate he has ingeniously wired for profit.

title: There's Something About a Soldier
description: Five young men train to become military officers.

title: The Black Knight
description: A common swordsmith (Alan Ladd) freelances for King Arthur to prove himself worthy of an earl's daughter (Patricia Medina).

title: Ten Cents a Dance
description: After marrying a man who becomes a thief, a taxi dancer runs off to Europe to get a divorce and marry another man.

title: The Last Hurrah
description: An aging New England politician struggles to maintain his position as mayor in a hard-fought and questionable campaign.

title: Gidget
description: A California girl called Gidget (Sandra Dee) spends summer with surf bums called Moondoggie (James Darren) and Kahuna (Cliff Robertson).

title: The Fuller Brush Man
description: A door-to-door salesman (Red Skelton) and his girlfriend (Janet Blair) solve a murder and wind up trapped in a war-surplus warehouse.

title: How to Save a Marriage and Ruin Your Life
description: A bachelor (Dean Martin) tries to save his buddy's (Eli Wallach) marriage by stealing his mistress, who is not who he thinks.

title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town
description: A folksy New England poet (Gary Cooper) inherits $20 million he doesn't want and tells a New York newswoman (Jean Arthur) why.

title: Love Has Many Faces
description: A woman (Lana Turner) lives in Acapulco with moochers and a husband (Cliff Robertson) who married her for her money.

title: In Cold Blood
description: Two ex-convicts (Robert Blake, Scott Wilson) are tried for the savage killing of a farm family in 1959 Kansas.

title: Easy Rider
description: Two free spirits (Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper) on chopped motorcycles clash with the Establishment and meet a boozy lawyer (Jack Nicholson) as they cross America.

title: The Mouse That Roared
description: The field marshal, prime minister and grand duchess (Peter Sellers) of Fenwick declare war on the United States.

title: The End of the Affair
description: A civil servant's wife (Deborah Kerr) in wartime London vows to leave her injured lover (Van Johnson) if he recovers.

title: First Men in the Moon
description: An old man (Edward Judd) recalls how he, his fiancée (Martha Hyer) and a professor (Lionel Jeffries) planted a Union Jack on the moon in 1899.

title: Human Desire
description: An Oklahoma train engineer's (Glenn Ford) lover (Gloria Grahame) wants him to kill her husband (Broderick Crawford).
